Placeholder pages, 'Photo' circles and low-resolution pictures are found automatically from index.html; list here only what needs a person to answer or send. 'label' is the page's PAGE label in index.html (its number is looked up at build time). Set "done": "<date>" to move an item to Recently done instead of deleting it.
